title: Lilli Hornig's Los Alamos typing interview

tellings.quote: when she arrived at Los Alamos and was being interviewed for a job, they asked her how fast she could type, and she said, "They don't teach typing at Harvard."

plain: When the chemist Lilli Hornig arrived at Los Alamos, the New Mexico laboratory where the atomic bomb was built in the 1940s, her job interviewers asked how fast she could type, and she answered, "They don't teach typing at Harvard." The physicist Kevin Knuth passes this on as something Hornig herself told him, and he tells it to show how a trained woman scientist was taken for a typist.
